description: Checks an e-invoice against the official rule sets on this machine: the XSD, the EN 16931 Schematron from CEN, and the KoSIT XRechnung or Peppol BIS rules when the document declares them. Use it before sending an invoice you created and when you receive one. To read the invoice's data use parse_invoice; to explain one failed rule in depth use explain_validation_rule. Accepts XML or a Factur-X / ZUGFeRD PDF, whose embedded XML is checked; syntax and profile are detected from the document. A `valid` result means the listed `ruleSets` passed, not that a tax authority or buyer will accept the invoice, so report which rule sets ran and never claim more. Each failure carries the publisher's message and, for common rules, a plain-language fix. Input that is not an invoice comes back as an error result, not as invalid. The check runs offline; nothing is uploaded.

country.description: Add a country layer: "FR" runs the French CTC rules (CII only); "DE" reports whether the profile is acceptable for German B2B (MINIMUM and BASIC WL are not).

pdfBase64.description: A Factur-X / ZUGFeRD PDF/A-3 as base64; the embedded XML is used. Provide this OR xml.

profile.description: Force the rule set instead of reading it from BT-24.

xml.description: The invoice as XML text (CII, UBL Invoice/CreditNote, XRechnung, Peppol BIS). Provide this OR pdfBase64.

xsd.description: Run XSD validation too. Default true.

name: validate_invoice

advisories.description: Warning or info rules that fired; they do not make the invoice invalid.

detected.description: What the document declares about itself.

customizationId.description: The BT-24 specification identifier as written in the document.

profile.description: Profile read from BT-24: en16931, xrechnung, peppol, extended, minimum, basicwl or unknown.

variant.description: XRechnung only: standard, extension or cvd.

embeddedFilename.description: PDF only: name of the embedded XML that was checked.

failures.description: Error-level rules that failed; any entry makes valid false.

element.description: The offending element without namespaces, e.g. LineTotalAmount.

fields.description: BT and BG ids named in the official message, in order.

line.description: 1-based invoice line number when the node is inside an invoice line.

message.description: The publisher's own message for this rule.

path.description: A short readable path, e.g. "line 1 > NetPriceProductTradePrice > ChargeAmount". xpath is the exact location.

plainLanguage.description: Plain-language explanation and fix, present for common rules and for the syntax rules (CII-DT, CII-SR, UBL-CR, UBL-DT, UBL-SR).

fix.description: How to change the invoice so the rule passes.

summary.description: What the rule requires, in plain language.

why.description: Why the rule exists or why it typically fires.

ruleId.description: Rule id from the publisher, e.g. BR-CO-15 or BR-DE-15.

ruleSet.description: Id of the rule set the rule belongs to (see ruleSets).

severity.description: error and fatal fail the invoice; warning and info do not. Effective level after the publisher's own re-levelling.

xpath.description: Where in the XML the rule fired.

firedCount.description: Schematron rules that fired across all rule sets.

notices.description: Findings about the document that are not Schematron rules, e.g. an unrecognised profile, or (with country DE) a profile not acceptable for German B2B. An error-level notice makes valid false.

origin.description: Whether the input was XML or a PDF.

ruleSets.description: Exactly the rule sets that ran. Report these; do not claim checks that are not listed.

advisory.description: Warning or info rules that fired without failing the invoice.

fired.description: Rules of this set that applied to the document.

id.description: Rule set id, e.g. en16931-cii or xrechnung-cii.

source.description: Publisher and version of the official artefact that ran.

summary.description: The verdict in numbers, with Conformo checks counted apart from the official rule sets.

conformoErrors.description: Conformo's own checks that failed (error-level notices), counted apart from the official rules.

official.description: What the official rule sets report.

xsdFailed.description: The XML schema check ran and failed.

valid.description: True only when no error-level rule failed, the XSD did not fail, and no error-level notice was raised.

skippedReason.description: Why XSD did not run, when it did not.

title: Validate an e-invoice
